title: Surat Thani 37-STC high-resolution drone baseline

project_geometry_reference.guard: EPSG:32647 is known for project geometry but is not assigned to the raw GeoTIFF until the TIFF georeference is read.

web_preview.derivation: Downsampled web preview derived from the confirmed Drive PNG source; raw GeoTIFF is not served by Vercel.

legacy_alignment_audit.reason: The legacy comparison app contains a boundary-only placeholder on the drone side, not orthomosaic pixels, so it is not accepted as georeferenced Drone-to-Sentinel evidence.

qa.raw_metadata_reason: The connected Drive API confirms the 3.33 GB TIFF exists but the raw-content action rejects files above 256 MB. No sidecar, flight log, GCP/RTK file, or photogrammetry metadata is present in the source folder. CRS, GSD, transform, band count, valid coverage and flight date therefore remain unverified rather than inferred.

scientific_guard: Do not derive an erosion/accretion rate from one drone epoch.
Do not call folder label 20-05-2569 a verified flight date until acquisition metadata confirms it.
Do not assign EPSG:32647 to the raw TIFF solely because the project boundary uses EPSG:32647.
Do not align the preview to Sentinel-2 or project geometry until GeoTIFF CRS/transform QA is complete.
Do not compute drone NDVI until the raw band configuration confirms a NIR band.
Do not use the rejected legacy placeholder as Drone-to-Sentinel alignment evidence.
Use the confirmed PNG preview as visual high-resolution spatial context only.
